segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Karen. I had you down for 18 full users and 27 read-only users for the calibration program. Is that still the right count for the first site?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Close. We need 20 full users now. Two supervisors asked to approve out-of-tolerance reports, so read-only won't work for them. The 27 read-only is fine.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. With 20 full and 27 read-only, on the annual plan, you're at $38,640 for software and $6,500 for onboarding. That includes the instrument import, two admin trainings, and the technician session.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the invoice can split onboarding from the subscription, right? Our finance team wants the services line hitting a different cost center.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can put those as separate lines on the same invoice. Subscription starts July 1, onboarding billed on signing. Net 30 unless you need something different.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 is fine. We are targeting go-live August 12. Is that realistic if we sign by June 21?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that works. The usual timeline is about six weeks. If we have your instrument export and the list of calibration procedures by July 3, August 12 is comfortable.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Contract term is one year, no auto-renewal. We can revisit next spring once the second plant decides.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. One-year term, July 1 through June 30, no auto-renewal language. I'll send the order form with those dates and the seat counts today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy Nate in finance. If the totals match what you just walked through, I can route it for signature tomorrow.
